messages:
Alex Kim: Quick heads-up — kicking off quant sweep for scarlet-13b bring-up. Targets: FP8 (fp8-e4m3), AWQ, GPTQ-INT8, plus a baseline GPTQ-fp16 fallback. Need a short operational playbook for deployment profiles (hosted/dedicated/private) and canary triggers. Who can take notes?
Sara Li: I'll capture. initial evals on the 2k goldenset show AWQ ~0.9% nominal delta vs fp16 on ROUGE-L, FP8 ~1.8% loss but 2.4x perf. GPTQ-int8 is in between.
Leo Park: Good. For deployments: hosted=low-latency path, dedicated=predictable throughput, private=opt-in only. I propose: hosted canaries small traffic to catch regressions fast; dedicated higher % because SLA-backed pools; private never auto-rollout without customer opt-in.
Vikram Rao: +1. Also need automatic fallback rules for regressions and safety signals. Suggest thresholds: accuracy delta > 1.2% absolute (ROUGE-L) OR semantic-similarity drop > 0.015 cosine => immediate rollback to fp16 variant. Also error-rate (inference exceptions) > 0.5% => rollback.
Sara Li: Add quality monitors: daily golden-run, streaming embedding similarity histogram, and sampling-based human eval on 200 cases. If rolling avg of golden-run fails 3/3 checks, trigger circuit-breaker.
Alex Kim: Can we express the canary percentages concretely? Put a short snippet we can copy to the routing config.
Leo Park: Sure — current draft:
```
canary:
  hosted: 0.5%
  dedicated: 5%
  private: 0%  # opt-in only
escalation:
  to: infra oncall
  if: [accuracy_drop >= 1.2, exceptions_rate >= 0.5]
fallback: scarlet-13b-fp16
```
Vikram Rao: Also add a time-based ramp: hosted 0.5% -> 2% after 30m if no regression, -> 10% after 6h. Dedicated can start at 5% -> 25% over 2h. Private requires manual opt-in.
Sara Li: On metrics collection, we'll attach differential quality delta per route and per user cohort. Need to watch for distribution shift — e.g., long prompts underperform on AWQ in preliminary logs.
Alex Kim: Who owns smoke tests and the canary-level eval job? Sara?
Sara Li: I will own the goldenset runs + human sampling. Leo can wire the alerting. Vikram you handle the fallback automation in the router.
Vikram Rao: Got it. I'll add a blackbox health check that calls `/v1/generate` with short and long prompts and asserts latency and deterministic outputs. If latency P95 > 1.5x baseline, scale down or route to fallback.
deploy-bot: Canary started for scarlet-13b-awq at 2024-10-03T10:12:30Z — hosted=0.5% dedicated=5% private=0%
Alex Kim: Nice. Last thing — record the exact quant profiles used in the rollout notes: AWQ v2 default, FP8 e4m3, GPTQ-int8 per shard with symmetric rounding. Sara, include that in the doc.
Sara Li: Will do. I'll post the summary doc + perf matrix in #eng-ml after the first 24h of canary data. Link to eval harness: https://internal.redwood/eval/scarlet-13b
Leo Park: One more operational note — add a soft-penalty routing rule to reduce traffic to quant variants if token error patterns spike (e.g., repeated <unk> tokens). Just reduce % by half immediately and trigger golden-run.
Alex Kim: Perfect. Thanks team — logging notes and next check-in at +24h. :rocket:
